behavior.description: Behavioral values in partial form: an absent field leaves the previous resolution plane's value in place. Resolved behavior must stay within every applicable ceiling.

ceiling_override.description: A scoped narrowing of the hard ceilings. Every present field must be less than or equal to the document ceiling; an attempt to widen rejects the document.

ceilings.description: Hard resource ceilings: non-overridable. Lower scopes may only narrow them.

fanout.description: Fan-out keys (#9111 record section 7.1, from #9144). Every key has a default; a value outside 1..=limit rejects the document, never clamped. per_peer_timeout_ms above deadline_ms is clamped to it at resolution.

remotes.description: The peers fan-out queries may ask (record section 7.1). Default [] (local-only). Resolved output is sorted by priority, ties in list order, with each remote's effective timeout_ms and scope filled in.

fanout_remote.description: One fan-out remote (#9111 record sections 7.1 to 7.3). peer_id must have a peers[] entry granting query.out whose class is fully_trusted or accept_signed_from, and appears at most once. relay true needs a fully_trusted peer with relay_granted. priority is ask order only, never authority. timeout_ms overrides the peer and fan-out per-peer timeout and is capped by deadline_ms; scope defaults to the peer's scope.

fixed_gates.description: The fixed admission gates (mechanism, not behavior). Each gate is const true: a document that attempts to disable one is rejected, never honored.

links.description: The link plane (#9111 record section 3.3): per-kind link defaults. An absent key or null takes the built-in default: every configurable kind off, adapter iroh, retention_class default. Who may use a link stays with peers[]; no link setting widens a class. Load rejects an adapter this build does not advertise (record section 6.5 step 4); this build advertises iroh.

control.description: Emergency peer disable and key revocation. Always on and not configurable: only {} or null is accepted.

timeout_ms.description: A direct query's timeout. Default: fanout.per_peer_timeout_ms.

peer.description: One peer relationship (#9111 record section 3.2; the #9141 PeerPolicy plus fan-out fields). The class is a ceiling and operations is the grant. Load rejects: relay_granted without fully_trusted; the relay operation without relay_granted; sync.accept on send_only; sync.send on accept_signed_from; any operation on unknown; a repeated operation; expires_at not after valid_from. peer_id is unique in the document.

overrides.description: Per-operation overrides keyed by a granted operation (record section 3.3). Each may choose only a link adapter this build advertises and a timeout; relay takes none. Class, gates and checks are not keys and cannot be overridden.

storage.description: The storage plane (#9111 record section 3.4): which adapter family backs each store. An absent key or null takes the built-in default. Load rejects an adapter or durability this build does not advertise (record section 6.5 step 4); this build advertises redb with fsync for local_store and event_log, and no object-store adapter.

event_log.description: The event log. Default sync_participation none.

local_store.description: The local persistent store. Default sync_participation full.

object_store.description: The object store. Absent or null means none.

tier.description: One tier's placement and retention (#9111 record section 3.5). An absent key or null takes the default. A tier label never authorizes access. Load rejects object_store placement unless storage.object_store is bound.

description: Canonical versioned configuration document for the id V2 program (slice 9111-01, issue #10178). Design basis: doc/2026-11-13T03-40-00Z_design_id-atlas-summit/crosscut/versioned-design.md, section 'Configuration data model and precedence' (statements S7.1, S7.10-S7.13). Kept in lockstep with the Rust contract in pkgs/id/crates/id-config by pkgs/id/tests/config_invariants.rs. Rules stated here and enforced by the reference validator: fixed admission gates cannot be disabled (const true), ceilings are hard and may only narrow at lower scopes, unknown fields reject the document, and extensions must be namespaced and are retained but never executed.

extensions.description: Namespaced optional extensions. Retained verbatim in resolved output; never executed unless understood and authorized by a consumer.

propertyNames.description: Extension keys must be namespaced: at least one '.' or '/' separator, e.g. 'example.com/experiment'.

mode.description: Named mode: a coherent behavior bundle that contributes behavioral defaults only. A mode cannot confer identity or privilege.

overrides.description: Scoped overrides. Applied in scope-name order during resolution; two overrides for the same scope reject the document.

peers.description: The peer plane: one entry per peer relationship; a repeated peer_id rejects the document. Absent means no configured peers. Resolved output is sorted by peer_id.

protocol_versions.description: Protocol-version allowlist. Resolved output is sorted; authoring order carries no meaning.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Only version 1 is accepted; any other version rejects the document.

tiers.description: The tier map (#9111 record section 3.5): tier identifier to placement and retention. Absent means every record is in the built-in default tier (local, indefinite). A record whose tier the map does not name is held in default placement and refused for placement-dependent operations.
